title: Purchase Receipt — the stock-committing buying document
description: A purchase receipt records goods arriving against a purchase order: the buying cycle's point of stock commitment. against_purchase_order is required for the same reason the delivery note requires its order — a receipt with no commitment behind it is a stock adjustment, which the model expresses as a stock-entry instead.

against_purchase_order.description: The purchase order this receipt fulfils. Required: the receipt exists to satisfy a commitment.

warehouse.description: The default receiving warehouse; a line may override it.

total.description: The received value, which the purchase invoice is raised against.

harvest: the purchase receipt field surface (supplier, against purchase order, warehouse, received lines)
the fulfilment link from a receipt back to the order it satisfies
receipt as the buying cycle's point of stock commitment
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream purchase receipt doctype, re-expressed. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
